name: Picnic
description: How wonderful it is to go to a park, lay down on a blanket, put down the dishes and desserts. Make a peanut butter jelly sandwich, and change engine oil... What a sight!
interestingFacts: The paint was released specifically for the meeting "Tanks in the City", which was held on September 8, 2018, in Krasnodar.
Also, the paint was available for purchase in the “{GAME} in Krasnodar” kit from August 25 to September 8, 2018.
